observations.body: The ship breaks while everyone reaches land. But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land. and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

payload.posture: Read Acts 27:27–44 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the ship breaks while everyone reaches land. But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land. and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
